name: slurry
description:
Inclusion Criteria

Slurry is liquid or semi-liquid matter, of a consistency that allows it to be pumped or discharged by gravity at any stage in the handling process.  There are many types of slurry but we are only interested in the following types:

Animal Slurry: Liquid waste generated specifically from livestock or animal operations.

Animal Manure: Refers specifically to the liquid or semi-liquid excrement of livestock (e.g. Cattle or Pig Manure).

Other Animal By-Products: Non-manure liquid wastes from animal farming (e.g. rainwater and washings from a building or yard used by yardstock, dairy wash, dairy whey).

We are interested in the handling, storage and processing of these types of slurry, including but not limited to the following areas:

Equipment and infrastructure (e.g. slurry tanks, lagoons, slurry stores, reception pits, lined lagoons, freeboard, structural integrity and secondary containment).

Land application controls (e.g. application rates, buffer zones, closed periods and muck spreading).

Environmental protection requirements (e.g. pollution, emissions, runoff and disease control and prevention).

Grants and funding.

High-Priority Keyword Matches

Use these specific terms to flag relevant texts only when used in a liquid or fluid storage or processing context.

Slurry, Organic slurry, Agricultural slurry, Farm slurry, Animal Slurry & Manure, Animal slurry, Livestock slurry, Animal manure, Cattle manure, Cow slurry, Dairy slurry, Pig manure, Swine slurry, Hog manure, Animal by-products, Dairy whey, Whey waste, Other inorganics (from animal processing).
